result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks active traffic control such as stop signs or signals. Sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the crossing point, and the wide turning radii may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the crosswalk can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street, just past the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or signals at the intersection to regulate vehicle flow and prioritize pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Stop Sign Installation
interventions.description: Install stop signs to clearly define right-of-way and slow traffic at the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban arterial with a high-visibility marked crosswalk but no median refuge or signalization. While sidewalks and a bike lane are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and wide road geometry suggest a high-speed environment that is challenging for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes and lack of vertical traffic calming elements encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire visible stretch of the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to the crosswalk to increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. However, safety is compromised by a large vehicle parked near the corner which creates a significant visual obstruction for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked at the curb near the zebra crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility and sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and physically prevent illegal parking at the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide better information to people crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and overhead traffic signals on a wide one-way street. However, the significant crossing distance and presence of large vehicles near the intersection create exposure and sightline challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from large vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck parked on the left side of the street near the intersection obstructs the sight lines between approaching drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: Wet pavement
hazards.description: Surface water near the crosswalk may increase vehicle stopping distances and create splashing hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.
